status: oracle-only feasibility protocol frozen before any two-view learning outputs
purpose: Determine whether the available controlled HER2ST data support a non-trivial downstream learning task before comparing candidate-pair confidence scores.

feature_protocol.source_view: even-indexed 50 genes from the 100 held-out genes
feature_protocol.target_view: odd-indexed 50 genes from the 100 held-out genes
feature_protocol.cost_independence: all 100 genes were excluded from OT cost construction

validation.candidate_pool: all target spots; test truth targets are not used for fitting

go_no_go_gate.rule: All conditions must pass. If the gate fails, do not compare maximum-probability and top-two-margin selection on this learner.

claim_boundary: Passing the gate only establishes that the frozen controlled two-view task is informative. It does not itself show that VALID-OT score selection improves learning, and it cannot establish real-section biological utility.
